company.description: Datasaur develops productive tools that design for data labelling needs. It enables users to assign multiple teammates to the same projects and use its specialized review tool to identify where they disagree. Also, its built-in intelligence catches costly errors.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for data labeling that improves the efficiency of NLP projects through structured annotation workflows.

productsAndServices.description: A platform to build, compare, and optimize custom Large Language Models using over 250 AI models to reduce project costs and improve model performance.
productsAndServices.name: LLM Labs

productsAndServices.description: A feature that automates NLP data labeling by using multiple Large Language Models simultaneously to generate label predictions and improve annotation accuracy.
productsAndServices.name: LLM-Assisted Labeling

productsAndServices.description: A specialized database for storing and managing vector embeddings of text data to provide domain-specific context for LLMs.
productsAndServices.name: Knowledge Base

productsAndServices.description: A tool to evaluate and optimize programmatic labeling functions by measuring coverage, overlap, and conflicts to improve automated data annotation accuracy.
productsAndServices.name: Data Programming - Labeling Function Analysis
